info.title: API.SH: The RealReal
info.description: The The RealReal API from API.SH: public The RealReal data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The RealReal's designer directory for one category (women, men, fine jewelry, watches, art, home, kids): id, name, slug, type and link of every designer, 500 per page, optionally narrowed by name or first letter. Use a designer's id or slug in /therealreal/v1/search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/therealreal-designers

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only designers whose name contains this text.

parameters.name: letter
parameters.description: Only designers starting with this letter (a-z, or # for digits and symbols).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search or browse The RealReal (authenticated luxury consignment) with every filter the shop has: keywords, a shop category path, designer (id or slug), condition, color, gender, store, category id, artist, clothing, shoe, ring and men's sizes, watch and jewelry attributes, editors' picks, items with tags, vintage, on sale, new today, hide sold items and a price range, in six sort orders (`sort=sold` lists sold items first, each with its last price). Also returns every filter with its values, ids and counts (pass a value's id back in the matching param), the sort options and, for keyword pages the site curates, the sale it opened. 120 products per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site lists the first 2,000 results).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/therealreal-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Optional when path or a filter is set.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Shop category path, e.g. women/handbags, women/handbags/shoulder-bags, men/clothing (a therealreal.com/shop/... link works too). Paths are in the Categories filter of the response.

parameters.name: designer
parameters.description: Designer ids from the Designers filter, e.g. 267 for Chanel (comma list = any of).

parameters.name: designer_slug
parameters.description: Designer slugs, e.g. chanel, hermes (comma list), from /therealreal/v1/designers.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition ids from the Condition filter (Pristine, Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair; comma list).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color ids from the Color & Patterns filter (comma list).

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender ids from the Gender filter (comma list).

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store ids from the Find in Store filter (comma list).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Category ids from the Categories filter (comma list).

parameters.name: clothing_size
parameters.description: Clothing size ids (comma list). Other size filters: shoe_size, ring_size, mens_waist, mens_inseam, mens_chest, mens_neck, kids_clothing_size, kids_shoe_size, art_size.

parameters.name: watch_style
parameters.description: Watch style ids (watch pages; comma list). Also movement, case_material, case_diameter, dial_color, complications.

parameters.name: metal_type
parameters.description: Jewelry metal ids (comma list). Also gemstone, stone_shape, stone_type, clarity_grade, color_grade, cut_grade.

parameters.name: new_today
parameters.description: true: items added to the site today only.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
